items.label: Very Best Quality
items.value: Blue Q Women's Crew Socks are woven from 56% soft, luxurious combed cotton for comfort, 42% nylon for strength and durability, and 2% spandex for long-lasting fun. The crisp, gorgeous graphics are vibrant and won't fade over time. Just right for daily, year-round wear.

items.label: Great Gift
items.value: Whether it's her birthday, the holidays, Mother's Day or just time to share a little love, Blue Q socks make a great gift. And they make any party just a little more fun when it comes time to open the presents.

items.label: Give back
items.value: 1% of the sale of Blue Q Socks supports the humanitarian work of Doctors Without Borders, the Nobel Peace Prize-winning first responders to emergencies, epidemics, and natural disasters around the world.
